## The heuristic

**Reserve auto-fail for genuinely unrecoverable errors — a promise outside entitlement, a data or security disclosure, a fabricated answer.**


_Why:_ Auto-fail is a blunt instrument that erases every other dimension on the sheet. Applied to recoverable lapses it makes the score a coin flip on whether a trigger happened to fire, and agents stop reading the rest of the sheet.
